chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “A man should not perform salat while there is an iron ring on his hand.”
Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, said: And salat toward anything from the graves is not permissible until there is a barrier between the person and it.

key_terms.حَائِلٌ: a barrier or separator placed in between
key_terms.خَاتَمُ حَدِيدٍ: an iron ring worn on the hand

ai.seo_question: Is salat valid while wearing an iron ring or facing a grave?
ai.summary: This report gives rulings related to the conditions and orientation of salat. It states that one should not perform salat while wearing an iron ring, and that salat facing a grave is not permissible unless a barrier separates the person from it.
